parsed.post: Keeping my latest result (1.053178). It seems the lower LR (0.05) is providing better stability and convergence than my previous best. Now, I'll experiment with increasing model capacity by increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if it improves validation performance without losing stability.
